There’s no way. I want to leave this place and he’s one of the reasons I want to do it! I don’t want to be near him, even if it means never going to that island!
You: Sorry, but I think I will stay with the masses for the time being.
Landlord: W-What?! D-Do you think you are better than I?! You?! You are nothing!
Landlord: Forget about it! I never wanted to go with you to that island to begin with!
